title: ADT brings ADT Blu to Walmart.com, expanding availability through one of the nation’s largest online retailers
summary: ADT Blu, a DIY home security system that customers can set up quickly and manage through the ADT+ app, is now available via the retail giant.
body_markdown:
ADT today announced that[ADT Blu, a do-it-yourself security solution](https://newsroom.adt.com/corporate-news/adt-blu-debuts-bringing-150-years-of-trusted-protection-to-diy-security-market) , is available for purchase on[Walmart.com](https://www.walmart.com/brand/adtblu/20069007) . This marks a milestone for ADT, expanding the availability of its products through a major retail channel and supporting the company’s focus on meeting customer needs in the DIY security market.


The self-installed home security system can be set up quickly and managed directly through the ADT+ app. The fully integrated app allows customers to arm and disarm the system, view live video, and receive notifications when people, packages, animals and vehicles are detected. Customers can also expand their system over time by adding devices as their needs evolve.


ADT Blu can be purchased without a long-term contract and installed without a technician visit. ADT Blu also provides customers with flexible monitoring options, allowing them to choose between 24/7 professional monitoring through ADT’s company-owned and -operated monitoring centers and self-monitoring.


“Bringing ADT Blu to Walmart.com makes it easier for consumers nationwide to purchase a DIY security system that’s backed by a company with more than 150 years of experience in home security,” said Kim Miller, ADT’s Chief Marketing & Communications Officer. “Every new retail channel introduces ADT Blu to more consumers and expands access to a solution that offers flexibility and peace of mind.”


“We’re excited to add ADT to Walmart Marketplace as a recognizable and trusted brand in the security and smart home solutions industry,” said Tomas Ponce De Leon, Vice President, Walmart U.S. Seller Acquisition and Onboarding. “Having ADT make its products available on Walmart.com strengthens our assortment and gives customers a convenient way to shop a brand they already know and trust.”


ADT will continue pursuing additional retail channels to expand the availability of its DIY product line.


**In addition to Walmart.com, ADT Blu is available on[ADT.com](https://www.adt.com/) and by phone at 1-800-ADT-ASAP. Learn more about ADT Blu at[ADT.com/Blu](https://www.adt.com/blu/) .**


**About ADT**
ADT is a leading provider of security, interactive and smart home solutions serving residential and small business customers in the U.S. Through innovative offerings, unrivaled safety and a premium customer experience delivered by the largest network of smart home security professionals in the U.S., ADT empowers people to protect and connect to what matters most, every second, every day. For more information, visit[ADT.com](https://www.adt.com/) .
